instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Strato Systems is a custom furniture manufacturer crafting solid wood pieces for high-end hospitality and residential projects. They utilize sophisticated CNC routing for repetitive components alongside traditional joinery techniques for premium finishing, focusing on quality craftsmanship.
answers.pastInitiatives: The company's digital transformation program has been active for three years under a dedicated office focused on operational efficiency. Significant achievements include migrating the ERP system to the cloud and implementing an RPA/low-code center of excellence, resulting in $2.4M in annualized cost savings.
answers.strategicGoals: Targeting 30% year-over-year top-line growth through aggressive market share capture and expansion into adjacent customer segments. The immediate focus is determining the optimal strategy: deepening vertical specialization or broadening horizontally into related product categories.
answers.teamSize: The R&D function comprises 10-12 engineers split between core product innovation and exploratory prototyping, supported by two dedicated data engineers.
answers.additionalContext: Strato Systems faces intense competition from both high-volume commodity producers and bespoke artisan firms. The current operational structure struggles to keep pace with the rapid demand for sustainable, highly customized interiors in the hospitality sector.

opportunities.title: Optimized Modular Component Library
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging existing CNC capabilities to develop a standardized library of modular structural components that can be rapidly configured for various hospitality and residential projects. This addresses lead time concerns without requiring full re-tooling.

first_actions: Audit current 20 core component designs for standardization potential
Pilot 3 new modular assembly jigs in the existing facility
Complete preliminary CAD modeling for 5 key standardized components
resources_needed: $15,000 for specialized tooling and software licenses
2 dedicated engineering hours/week from R&D team
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce average custom project assembly time by 1.5 weeks within Q3.
milestones: Q2: Pilot program successfully deployed and data collected
End of Q3: Initial cost-benefit analysis complete for scale

opportunities.title: Advanced Sustainable Material Prototyping (Bio-Resin)
opportunities.rationale: Develop a radical new product line using bio-resins and advanced composite materials that offer superior structural integrity and sustainability compared to traditional solid wood. This capitalizes on the high regulatory environment by positioning the company as an early adopter of green manufacturing.

first_actions: Establish partnership with a university research lab for material testing
Allocate $50,000 for specialized bio-resin tooling and pilot batch production
Form a cross-functional 'Sustainability Task Force' led by the transformation office
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Launch 1 fully sustainable product prototype with positive customer feedback score > 4/5.
milestones: Q2: Material viability testing and safety certification
Q3: Successful small-scale production run (10 units)
End of Q4: Initial market penetration testing for new materials

next_steps.action: Conduct a rapid internal assessment of existing component modularity and identify the top 3 highest-impact incremental improvements.
Develop a preliminary business case for the radical sustainable material initiative, focusing on ROI against long-term regulatory compliance and market differentiation.
Establish a dedicated inter-departmental task force to streamline cross-functional communication bottlenecks between R&D, operations, and the transformation office.

key_weaknesses: High reliance on informal decision-making despite a formal process structure, leading to execution velocity inconsistencies.
Budget constraints limit the ability to pursue high-CAPEX radical innovations without significant external funding or strategic partnerships.
Digital infrastructure silos and lack of seamless integration between ERP/CRM systems hinder data-driven design iteration.
Slow internal bureaucracy in moving from formal R&D concept approval to pilot testing.
